title: Fire Alarm Inspection Checklist
subtitle: Fire Alarm Inspection: documents findings, limits, and disposition.
description: Fire Alarm Inspection Checklist covers fire alarm control unit, initiating devices, notification appliances, and interfaces. The facility fire-alarm coordinator records Fire Alarm Inspection criteria, findings, restrictions, and follow-up. Fire Alarm Inspection Checklist keeps Fire Alarm Inspection exceptions visible until the facility fire-alarm coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Fire Alarm Inspection Checklist at protected premises, panel location, zones, and sampled device locations. Document fire alarm control unit, initiating devices, notification appliances, and interfaces identity before Fire Alarm Inspection begins. Compare fire alarm control unit, initiating devices, notification appliances, and interfaces findings with stated Fire Alarm Inspection criteria; route unresolved Fire Alarm Inspection issues to qualified fire-alarm inspection supervisor. For Fire Alarm Inspection Checklist, confirm requirements for Fire Alarm Inspection. Ask qualified fire-alarm inspection supervisor to review Fire Alarm Inspection conditions beyond the facility fire-alarm coordinator's role.

sections.title: Inspector, location, and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Fire Alarm Inspection, identify responsible parties, protected premises, panel location, zones, and sampled device locations, and the linked fire alarm control unit, initiating devices, notification appliances, and interfaces source.

fields.label: Panel make, model, and system identifier
Inspection scope, device list, and monitoring reference

sections.title: Observed conditions and item decisions
sections.guidance: Capture Fire Alarm Inspection facts for fire alarm control unit, initiating devices, notification appliances, and interfaces; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Fire Alarm Inspection checks
items: Panel normal, trouble, supervisory, and alarm status
Interface, shutdown, and release function evidence
Impairment notice, fire watch, and restoration state

columns.label: Pass, issue, N/A, or not inspected

sections.title: Inspection disposition and reviewer acknowledgment
sections.guidance: Use observed Fire Alarm Inspection evidence to state disposition. Keep limits visible and give Facility Fire-Alarm Coordinator both correction and repeat-check responsibility.

blocks.label: Deficiencies, restrictions, and retained evidence
items: Alarm or supervisory signal not received
Device inventory or prior deficiency cannot be reconciled
blocks.guidance: Pause Fire Alarm Inspection when any required fire-alarm function is impaired without approved interim protection and accountable restoration. Retain the available Fire Alarm Inspection proof and route unresolved fire alarm control unit, initiating devices, notification appliances, and interfaces scope to facility fire-alarm coordinator.
